title: Weeks 1 and 2
description: Questions to test your knowledge of the material of week 1 and 2

questions.text: When working with large software systems, which approach is more sensible?
options: To understand the source code completely.
To memorise all the tools used in the system.
To learn every single detail of the system.
To keep moving forward, even when not fully understanding all aspects.

questions.text: What is the primary purpose of forking a repository on GitLab?
options: To make changes directly to the original repository.
To share the repository with other users.
To create a personal copy of the repository to experiment with changes.
To archive the repository for future reference.

questions.text: Which command is used to stage changes in Git before committing?
Which of the following are useful Git commands for inspecting repository state?
Match the capability with the generation of C++ that introduced it
